授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）:
生物生産環境工学分野にかかる分野に就職した卒業生を中心に，第1戦で活躍する先輩から，実体験を拝聴しながら，就職意欲と勉学意欲の向上を目指す．生物生産環境工学分野では，国家公務員，地方公務員，ゼネコン，建設開発コンサルタンツ，研究者，教員など幅広い分野に人材を共有している．卒業生の実体験を拝聴し，学生の社会貢献意欲を駆り立てる．同時に，大学院の魅力を伝えるために，若手教員などによる研究室紹介を行う．また，実際の事業実施現場に出向いて，活躍の現場を視察し，就職意欲を実体験させる．座学，懇談会，現地視察　など多様．
<九州大学生物生産環境工学プログラム（JABEE認定）の学習教育到達目標との対応＞
生物生産環境工学概論は，「C 技能（C1 専門的能力）：生物生産環境工学技術者として必要な知識・技術の修得」において，「C1-1 農業農村工学・農業環境工学領域の専門基礎の理解」を主体的に含む科目である．
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
In this class (Introduction of Agro-production and Environmental Engineering), students can understand what they can contribute to the society including international society in the future and what kinds of jobs they can take after learning all the classes of this department.  And students can identify “Agro-production and Environmental Engineering “ JABEE course program. The students can obtain active knowledge from mainly the superiors who have been working at the front line at each jobs.
At the class, at first, the mission and outline of the class, introduction of the JABEE program are informed. After that, guidance on each job concerning its outline, lifestyle and ethics etc. are provided from each lecturer. Especially, from the lectures from outside, the students can obtain what kinds of contribution can they expect to do in the future after completion the whole learning course of the department and they can enhance the necessity of the related knowledges and they can identify their importance of their jobs. In addition, information on the engineers education scheme which is provided by our education course is explained and they can visit real implementation fields sites and they can communicate with the relating many engineers, there, also.
In the curriculum of our department, this “Introduction class “ is including both basic and advanced knowledges and the students can identify the knowledge mainly on soil, water & meteorology. The students can understand roughly without specific knowledge on our research fields.
	Comparison with the JABEE , “Irrigation & Drainage and rural Engineering” program, the student can obtain the same contents.
This “Introduction of Agro-production and environmental program” contains both “B; Capability of understanding cultural diversity and issues which the society has been facing, and at the “C; Obtain required knowledge and skills which are required for Irrigation, drainage and rural engineers” and “C2; Understanding of planning and operation of the implementation on soil, water, base and environmental science.
	Comparison with JABEE certification 1 (2)
“Introduction of Agro-production and environmental engineering” mainly includes required “d; basic knowledge and its applied capability of this department or learning course, namely JABEE “Irrigation, drainage and rural engineering” program.
